subject: Native mobile defect fixes - wave 1 (themed system bars, Impossible hidden, press-hold preview)

ios.note: not exercised in this wave; the Swift change is compiled by CI, not device-verified here

defect_1_impossible_level.requirement: The playable Impossible level must not appear anywhere in the app; the training-data collection / pack engine stays compiled.
entryPointsRemovedFromUi: home(): the conditionally rendered IMPOSSIBLE difficulty chip in the bot setup
home(): the 'Impossible AI pack: Manage/Setup' full button and its enclosing MegaAiPack block
statsView(): the 'Impossible (Local AI)' option in both Bot-difficulty selects
statsView(): the dedicated 'Impossible mode' stats page and its Recent games ledger
statsDifficulty is coerced to one of the G.LEVELS values or 'all', so a saved 'Impossible' can never reach a removed branch
enginePreserved: src/bot/* entirely untouched (pack-ui, local-ai, local-session, neural-* , contracts)
openNeuralRecovery, LA, localSession, window.MegaAiPack, the aipack action handler and MegaApp.startImpossible remain

tests.cmd: node --test tests/static-ui.test.js tests/v5-p0-acceptance-triage.test.js tests/bot/impossible-session.test.cjs tests/bot/pack.test.cjs tests/bot/local-ai.test.cjs tests/v5-p21-board.test.js

measuredBefore.method: read raw screenshot pixels via adb exec-out screencap + ffmpeg crop, and CDP getBoundingClientRect on the running app
measuredBefore.whiteBands: status bar rows y=4..114 and navigation bar rows y=2385..2399 were #f7f9fc in every theme; the app surface was #0f0722 (afterhours) / #f6efdc (paperclub)
measuredBefore.topbarOverflow: cssViewport 360 px: .header-actions right edge 368.4 (paperclub) and 368.7 (afterhours) vs 360 usable - the settings button was clipped 8.4-8.7 px off-screen; .brand measured 151.5 px in paperclub

nativeFix.bridge: window.MegaNativeTheme.apply({theme,dark,surface}) published by MegaAndroidThemeBridge (WebViewCompat.addWebMessageListener + addDocumentStartJavaScript, origin- and entry-scoped, #rrggbb validated) and by MegaNativeThemeBridge (WKScriptMessageHandler, contentWorld .page, entry-scoped)
nativeFix.androidPaints: statusBarColor, navigationBarColor, decorView and WebView background, and the bar icon appearance from the dark flag
nativeFix.compiles: BUILD SUCCESSFUL (gradle 8.13, :app:assembleOfflineDebug); only pre-existing deprecation warnings
nativeFix.guardPreserved: the new bridge uses WebViewCompat, not addJavascriptInterface, so tests/v5-native-foundations.test.js keeps passing

verifiedAfterOnDevice.conclusion: every theme's bars are painted the theme's own surface colour; the white bands are gone. The 1-2 value difference from the CSS --surface is the platform's own bar scrim, not a mismatch.

cssHalf.status: in progress by a parallel slice: the paperclub/afterhours 360 px topbar overflow (settings button clipped) and the page-level fluidity work

screenshots.before-paperclub.png: sha256:e6b61c4284234aaa... (prefix); paperclub with clipped settings button and white status/nav bands
screenshots.after-paperclub.png: sha256:876d390f67c17051... (prefix); same theme after the native fix

defect_5_press_hold_preview.requirement: On a phone, pressing and holding a cell must show where the move sends the opponent, matching the web hover preview.
defect_5_press_hold_preview.implementation: src/app.js buildBoard(): a 200 ms pointerdown timer on touch/pen calls the existing preview(b,c) (cell highlight plus, when the Destination-preview setting is on, the destination mini-board highlight and the 'This sends your opponent to the ... board.' line); pointerup/pointercancel/pointerleave clears it and suppresses the follow-up click so a hold previews without moving; mouse keeps pointerenter/pointerleave hover.

notClaimed: iOS device verification of the themed bars
the CSS topbar-overflow fix (still in flight at the time of this record)
